title: Bun upload and file server
context: Adds a Bun file server. Uploads are limited to 5 MB and every file must stay inside /srv/uploads. Error responses must never expose internals such as stack traces.
code: if (!(file instanceof File)) return new Response("missing file", { status: 400 });
if (file.size > MAX_BYTES) return new Response("too large", { status: 413 });
if (f.size > MAX_BYTES * 20) return new Response("too large", { status: 413 });

expected.why: client-supplied file name is joined unsanitised, so ../ in the name writes outside the upload directory
decoded name containing ../ escapes the upload directory (path traversal on read)
the file's existence is never checked (await f.exists()), so a missing file gives an error instead of 404
stack trace is returned to the client, exposing internals
